title_idea: EU Imposes Provisional Safeguard Measures on Grain-Oriented Electrical Steel Including Laminations, Cores and Transformer-Integrated Cores
keyword: EU provisional safeguard measures grain-oriented electrical steel tariff rate quota price threshold 2026 importer cost
angle: This article lets importers of grain-oriented electrical steel, laminations, cores and finished transformers containing integrated cores confirm the scope of new provisional EU safeguard rules and plan their import volumes to avoid unexpected additional duties.

figures.source: European Commission Directorate-General for Trade and Economic Security
figures.evidence: After analysing input received from interested parties during an investigation launched in March 2026, the Commission concluded that provisional measures were urgently needed to protect a strategic EU industry that is under threat from high import pressure – fuelled by global overcapacities and the closure of traditional export markets.

figures.period: applicable to all EU safeguard investigations
figures.source: European Commission Directorate-General for Trade and Economic Security
figures.evidence: A safeguard investigation must normally be completed within nine months but, in exceptional circumstances, may be extended to 11 months.
